Here are 30 companies. I wrote this list from memory and didn't open any of the links, so a few URLs may have moved. Where the source is a GitHub repo rather than a company statement, it shows the company ships a Rust product, not that they said "we use Rust in production".

```json
[
  {"company": "Cloudflare", "use": "Pingora and Oxy proxies that carry Cloudflare's edge traffic", "source": "https://blog.cloudflare.com/how-we-built-pingora-the-proxy-that-connects-cloudflare-to-the-internet/"},
  {"company": "Discord", "use": "Read States service, rewritten from Go to Rust", "source": "https://discord.com/blog/why-discord-is-switching-from-go-to-rust"},
  {"company": "Dropbox", "use": "Sync engine (Nucleus) rewrite", "source": "https://dropbox.tech/infrastructure/rewriting-the-heart-of-our-sync-engine"},
  {"company": "Amazon Web Services", "use": "Firecracker microVMs, Bottlerocket OS and other infrastructure", "source": "https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/opensource/why-aws-loves-rust-and-how-wed-like-to-help/"},
  {"company": "Microsoft", "use": "Safe systems programming, including Windows components and Azure", "source": "https://msrc.microsoft.com/blog/2019/07/why-rust-for-safe-systems-programming/"},
  {"company": "Google", "use": "Android platform code", "source": "https://security.googleblog.com/2021/04/rust-in-android-platform.html"},
  {"company": "Meta", "use": "Server-side services and source control tooling (Rust is an endorsed server-side language)", "source": "https://engineering.fb.com/2022/07/27/developer-tools/programming-languages-endorsed-for-server-side-use-at-meta/"},
  {"company": "Mozilla", "use": "Stylo CSS engine in Firefox", "source": "https://hacks.mozilla.org/2017/11/entering-the-quantum-era-how-firefox-got-fast-again-and-where-its-going-next/"},
  {"company": "Figma", "use": "Multiplayer sync server", "source": "https://www.figma.com/blog/rust-in-production-at-figma/"},
  {"company": "npm, Inc.", "use": "Registry authorization service", "source": "https://www.rust-lang.org/static/pdfs/Rust-npm-Whitepaper.pdf"},
  {"company": "Buoyant (Linkerd)", "use": "linkerd2-proxy service mesh data plane", "source": "https://linkerd.io/2020/07/23/under-the-hood-of-linkerds-state-of-the-art-rust-proxy-linkerd2-proxy/"},
  {"company": "Canonical", "use": "Ubuntu core utilities (sudo-rs, uutils)", "source": "https://discourse.ubuntu.com/t/carefully-but-purposefully-oxidising-ubuntu/56995"},
  {"company": "Vercel", "use": "Turbopack bundler", "source": "https://vercel.com/blog/turbopack"},
  {"company": "Deno Land", "use": "Deno JavaScript/TypeScript runtime", "source": "https://github.com/denoland/deno"},
  {"company": "Astral", "use": "Ruff linter and uv package manager", "source": "https://github.com/astral-sh/uv"},
  {"company": "Materialize", "use": "Streaming SQL database", "source": "https://github.com/MaterializeInc/materialize"},
  {"company": "InfluxData", "use": "InfluxDB IOx time-series engine", "source": "https://www.influxdata.com/blog/announcing-influxdb-iox/"},
  {"company": "PingCAP", "use": "TiKV distributed key-value store", "source": "https://github.com/tikv/tikv"},
  {"company": "Mullvad", "use": "VPN app and daemon", "source": "https://github.com/mullvad/mullvadvpn-app"},
  {"company": "Signal", "use": "libsignal cryptographic core", "source": "https://github.com/signalapp/libsignal"},
  {"company": "Oxide Computer", "use": "Rack control plane and firmware", "source": "https://github.com/oxidecomputer/omicron"},
  {"company": "Svix", "use": "Webhook sending service", "source": "https://github.com/svix/svix-webhooks"},
  {"company": "Shopify", "use": "WebAssembly-based Shopify Functions", "source": "https://shopify.engineering/shopify-webassembly"},
  {"company": "Sentry", "use": "Symbolicator and native event processing", "source": "https://github.com/getsentry/symbolicator"},
  {"company": "Embark Studios", "use": "Game development tooling and engine code", "source": "https://github.com/EmbarkStudios"},
  {"company": "Fastly", "use": "Compute@Edge runtime (Viceroy)", "source": "https://github.com/fastly/Viceroy"},
  {"company": "Datadog", "use": "Vector observability data pipeline", "source": "https://github.com/vectordotdev/vector"},
  {"company": "Hugging Face", "use": "Tokenizers and safetensors", "source": "https://github.com/huggingface/tokenizers"},
  {"company": "Parity Technologies", "use": "Polkadot/Substrate blockchain stack", "source": "https://github.com/paritytech/polkadot-sdk"},
  {"company": "Solana Labs", "use": "Solana validator and blockchain runtime", "source": "https://github.com/solana-labs/solana"}
]
```

I can fetch each link and replace any that fail, if you'd like.
